title: Relationship Pricing Memorandum — AutoDraft Increment on Equipment & Vehicle Loans Autopay Enrolments
content:
**Terms.** An autopay relationship increment is added to the autopay discount granted on an Equipment & Vehicle Loans enrolment: 0.04 point when the member holds an operating line in active status that collects its interest by AutoDraft and none of the member's operating lines carries a late charge dated less than 12 whole months before the enrolment date; 0.02 point when the member holds such an AutoDraft operating line in active status and one of the member's operating lines carries a late charge dated less than 12 whole months before the enrolment date; and nothing otherwise. The rate reduction on an enrolment is the granted autopay discount plus the autopay relationship increment, limited to the product's rate discount cap less the relationship discount received at funding; that reduction is subtracted from the contract rate on record, and only the resulting rate is rounded to 3 decimal places before the rate floor is applied.

## Records the increment rests on

The member's Operating Lines of Credit: each line's status, whether it collects its interest by AutoDraft, and the late-charge fee entries in the lines' transaction history.

## Increment by combination

| Operating line in active status collecting interest by AutoDraft | Late charge on any of the member's operating lines within 12 whole months | Increment |
|---|---|---|
| yes | no | 0.04 point |
| yes | yes | 0.02 point |
| no | either | nothing |

## Hypothetical figures (Used Equipment Loan, contract rate on record 7.300, cap 0.35)

- Discount granted 0.25, AutoDraft line active, no line late charge in 12 months, no relationship discount received at funding: the reduction is 0.25 plus 0.04, that is 0.29, within the cap of 0.35; the rate is 7.010.
- Discount granted 0.25 with a relationship discount of 0.15 received at funding: the room under the cap is 0.20, so 0.29 is limited to 0.20 and the rate is 7.100.
- A member whose only operating line on AutoDraft is suspended rather than active receives no increment.
